The figure uses the existing state variable from the
[COAT data portal](https://data.coat.no/state-variable/v85_snowbed_dwarf_shrub_abundance_intensive_v2).

The figure is interactive. You can:

- Hover over points to inspect values.
- Zoom and pan.
- Hide or show species using the legend.
- Reset the view using the plot controls.



```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

required_packages <- c(
  "ckanr",
  "dplyr",
  "plotly"
)

missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(
    required_packages,
    requireNamespace,
    quietly = TRUE,
    FUN.VALUE = logical(1)
  )
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "The following R packages are missing: ",
    paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "),
    ". Install them once before rendering this document."
  )
}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ckanr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(plotly)
})

source(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/COATnor/data_management_scripts/master/download_data_from_coat_data_portal.R"
)

if (!nzchar(Sys.getenv("api_COAT"))) {
  stop(
    "The environment variable 'api_COAT' is not available. ",
    "Add it to your local .Renviron file before rendering."
  )
}

ckanr::ckanr_setup(
  url = "https://data.coat.no",
  key = Sys.getenv("api_COAT")
)
```

```{r}
#| label: download-data
#| include: false

years <- 2009:2024

filenames <- paste0(
  "V85_snowbed_dwarf_shrub_abundance_intensive_",
  years,
  ".txt"
)

dat_list <- download_coat_data(
  name = "v85_snowbed_dwarf_shrub_abundance_intensive_v2",
  filenames = filenames,
  store = "session"
)

if (length(dat_list) == 0L) {
  stop("No data were downloaded.")
}

dat <- dplyr::bind_rows(dat_list)

if (nrow(dat) == 0L) {
  stop("The downloaded data contain no rows.")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: prepare-data
#| include: false

species_codes <- c(
  "bet_nan",
  "emp_nig",
  "vac_myr",
  "vac_vit"
)

species_labels <- c(
  bet_nan = "Betula nana",
  emp_nig = "Empetrum nigrum",
  vac_myr = "Vaccinium myrtillus",
  vac_vit = "Vaccinium vitis-idaea"
)

species_colours <- c(
  "Betula nana" = "#468f9b",
  "Empetrum nigrum" = "#df8600",
  "Vaccinium myrtillus" = "#D44100",
  "Vaccinium vitis-idaea" = "#925A00"
)

dat_site <- dat |>
  dplyr::filter(
    v_species %in% species_codes,
    sn_locality != "ifjordfjellet",
    t_year != 2017
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(
    sn_region,
    sn_locality,
    sn_section,
    sn_site,
    t_year,
    v_species
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    v_abundance = sum(v_abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    proportion = v_abundance / 48
  )

dat_plot <- dat_site |>
  dplyr::group_by(
    sn_region,
    t_year,
    v_species
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(proportion)),
    proportion_mean = mean(proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
    standard_deviation = sd(proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
    standard_error = standard_deviation / sqrt(n),
    t_critical = ifelse(
      n > 1,
      stats::qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
      NA_real_
    ),
    lower_ci = proportion_mean - t_critical * standard_error,
    upper_ci = proportion_mean + t_critical * standard_error,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    lower_ci = dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(lower_ci),
      proportion_mean,
      pmax(lower_ci, 0)
    ),
    upper_ci = dplyr::if_else(
      is.na(upper_ci),
      proportion_mean,
      pmin(upper_ci, 1)
    ),
    full_species = unname(species_labels[v_species]),
    colour = unname(species_colours[full_species]),
    hover_text = paste0(
      "Species: ", full_species,
      "<br>Region: ", sn_region,
      "<br>Year: ", t_year,
      "<br>Mean proportion: ",
      round(proportion_mean, 3),
      "<br>Lower 95% CI: ",
      round(lower_ci, 3),
      "<br>Upper 95% CI: ",
      round(upper_ci, 3),
      "<br>Number of sites: ", n
    )
  )
```

## Interactive figure

```{r}
#| label: interactive-figure
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6

# Set a dynamic y-axis limit based on the highest confidence interval.
# Add 10% headroom above the maximum value.
y_max <- max(dat_plot$upper_ci, na.rm = TRUE)

if (!is.finite(y_max) || y_max <= 0) {
  y_max <- 0.1
}

y_axis_max <- min(1, y_max * 1.10)

species_present <- unique(dat_plot$full_species)

p <- plotly::plot_ly()

for (species_name in species_present) {
  species_data <- dat_plot |>
    dplyr::filter(full_species == species_name)

  species_colour <- unique(species_data$colour)

  p <- p |>
    plotly::add_ribbons(
      data = species_data,
      x = ~t_year,
      ymin = ~lower_ci,
      ymax = ~upper_ci,
      name = paste0(species_name, " 95% CI"),
      legendgroup = species_name,
      fillcolor = species_colour,
      line = list(color = "transparent"),
      opacity = 0.20,
      hoverinfo = "skip",
      showlegend = FALSE
    )

  p <- p |>
    plotly::add_trace(
      data = species_data,
      x = ~t_year,
      y = ~proportion_mean,
      type = "scatter",
      mode = "lines+markers",
      name = species_name,
      legendgroup = species_name,
      line = list(
        color = species_colour,
        width = 3
      ),
      marker = list(
        color = species_colour,
        size = 7
      ),
      text = ~hover_text,
      hoverinfo = "text"
    )
}

p |>
  plotly::layout(
    title = list(
      text = "Dwarf shrub abundance in snowbeds"
    ),
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Year",
      dtick = 1
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Proportion of subplots with dwarf shrubs",
      range = c(0, y_axis_max),
      tickformat = ".2f"
    ),
    hovermode = "x unified",
    legend = list(
      title = list(text = "Species")
    )
  ) |>
  plotly::config(
    displaylogo = FALSE,
    responsive = TRUE,
    modeBarButtonsToRemove = c(
      "lasso2d",
      "select2d"
    )
  )
```
::: {.figure-caption}

**Dwarf shrub abundance in snowbeds on the Varanger Peninsula.** Dwarf shrub
abundance is calculated as the mean proportion of subplots with dwarf shrub
presence. Visit the [COAT data portal](https://data.coat.no/state-variable/v85_snowbed_dwarf_shrub_abundance_intensive_v1)
for more information about the sampling design and dataset.

:::
## Data and provenance

The data were downloaded from the COAT data portal using the existing state
variable:

```text
v85_snowbed_dwarf_shrub_abundance_intensive_v2
```

The following filters were applied:

- Species: `bet_nan`, `emp_nig`, `vac_myr`, and `vac_vit`
- Locality excluded: `ifjordfjellet`
- Year excluded: `2017`
- Number of subplots per site: `48`
- Years included: `2009` to `2024`

The figure is generated from an existing published state variable on the COAT Data Portal. This
document does not calculate a new state-variable version, upload files, or
modify metadata on the COAT data portal.

## Source and attribution

This document is based on the existing plotting script:

```text
state_variable_figure_v85_dwarf_shrub_abundance.Rmd
```
by Hanna Böhner.

The original script was adapted to:

- Use Quarto and HTML output.
- Create an interactive Plotly figure.
- Use the existing state variable from the COAT data portal.
- Avoid saving figures to Box.
- Avoid installing packages while rendering.
- Avoid uploading or modifying data on the COAT data portal.
- Produce an output suitable for later publication through GitHub Pages.
